hooks.command: if [ -n "${WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR:-}" ]; then bash "$WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR/emit-hook.sh" codex agent.session.start; else command -v wtcli.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source codex --event agent.session.start; fi; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "try { if ([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR')) { & (Join-Path ([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR')) 'emit-hook.ps1') -CliSource codex -Event agent.session.start } else { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source codex --event agent.session.start } } catch { }; exit 0"
